sessions.prompt:
Add a Restaurants class to restaurants.py with add(name), add_dish(name, dish, price), which puts a dish on a restaurant's menu, price(name, dish), and dishes(name): the restaurant's dishes in the order they were added. An unknown restaurant or dish raises KeyError. Add tests.

The plan for Restaurants.dishes has one more step: the dishes are sorted by price, cheapest first, and by dish name for the same price. Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Add an Orders class to orders.py. Orders(restaurants) works on a Restaurants, kept as its attribute restaurants. place(rest, items, km, minute) places an order and returns an order id: an int counter that starts at 1; items is a list of (dish, qty) tuples, km the delivery distance and minute the time of the order. get(oid) returns the order as a tuple (rest, items, km, minute). An unknown restaurant or id raises KeyError. Add tests.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): every dish of an order must be on the restaurant's menu; an order with another dish raises ValueError and places nothing.

Add subtotal(orders, oid) to fees.py: the price times the qty of each item, added up. Add tests.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): a restaurant delivers at most 10 km; a longer distance raises ValueError and places nothing.

Add delivery_fee(orders, oid) to fees.py. Add tests.

Design decision for this project: the delivery fee is a base fee of 299 cents plus 50 cents per km.

Add Orders.status(oid), which is "placed" for a new order, and Orders.set_status(oid, status). Add tests.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): an order goes through the statuses "placed", "cooking", "out", "delivered" in that order; set_status to any status other than the next one raises ValueError and changes nothing.

Add service_fee(orders, oid) to fees.py. Add tests.

Design decision for this project: the service fee is 5% of the subtotal, rounded to the nearest cent.

Add Orders.of_restaurant(rest): the ids of the restaurant's orders, in id order. Add tests.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): the subtotal of an order is at least 1000 cents; a smaller order raises ValueError and places nothing.

Add total(orders, oid) to fees.py: the subtotal plus the delivery fee plus the service fee plus any rush fee. Add tests.

Design decision for this project: an order placed from minute 1080 to minute 1199 (18:00 to 19:59) pays a rush fee of 150 cents.

Add receipt(orders, oid) to export.py: a list of text lines: "restaurant: <name>", "subtotal: <cents>", "total: <cents>". Add tests.

The plan for receipt has one more step: right after the restaurant line it has the line "km: <km>", the distance (for example "km: 3"). Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): the delivery base fee is 349 cents, not 299.

Add Orders.items_count(oid): the qty of all the order's items added up. Add tests.

Design decision for this project: delivery is free (the delivery fee is 0) when the subtotal is 3000 cents or more.

Add export_orders(orders, path) to export.py: a CSV file with one row per order, in id order: id, restaurant and total. Add tests.

The plan for export_orders has one more step: the rows are sorted by restaurant name, and by id for the same restaurant. Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Design decision for this project: an exported orders file starts with the header line id,restaurant,total and uses "," as the delimiter.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): delivery costs 60 cents per km, not 50.

Add Restaurants.remove(name), which removes a restaurant; an unknown name raises KeyError. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): the subtotal of an order is at least 1500 cents, not 1000.

Add Orders.open_ids(): the ids of the orders that are not delivered, in id order. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): the service fee is 7% of the subtotal, not 5%.

Add Orders.cancel(oid), which removes an order that is still "placed"; an order with any other status raises ValueError and stays. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): delivery is free when the subtotal is 2500 cents or more, not 3000.

Add revenue(orders) to fees.py: the totals of the delivered orders added up. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): the delivery base fee is 329 cents, not 349.

Add Orders.count(): the number of orders. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): delivery costs 45 cents per km, not 60.

Add Restaurants.names(): the sorted restaurant names. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): the subtotal of an order is at least 1200 cents, not 1500.
Add Orders.at_status(status): the ids of the orders with that status, in id order. Add tests.

Add Orders.busiest(): the restaurant with the most orders (the first in name order on a tie), or None when there are no orders. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): the service fee is 6% of the subtotal, not 7%.
Add Orders.km_total(): the delivery distances of all orders added up. Add tests.
Add Orders.ids(): all order ids in order. Add tests. Then finish any work that earlier sessions left for later.
